svg.title: Boundary and reflection spaces use their respective unitary recovery maps. A constructed attachment J is lifted as JZ = U −1 ref JUbdry. This preserves its isometry property and, when the supplied density argument proves onto range, its surjectivity. Isometry alone supplies no surjectivity argument. Tested boundary distributions remain those of the same hierarchy, with their original gap bounds and derivative requirements, by Theorem B.1.
